QuestInfo.name: Making a Sparkling Rock
QuestInfo.1: I met #p510# in #m10004002#. She told me that she's working on her dream of becoming an alchemist. To make the Sparkling Rock, she says she needs #b30 #t4000006#s#k, #b30 #t4000011#s#k, #b30 #t4000012#s#k, and #b1 #t4031010##k. Everything looks reasonable enough... wait, #t4031010#?! Fortunately, #p510# knew where to get some. She told me to have a chat with #p502#, who should be somewhere around #m10004000#.
QuestInfo.2: #p510# told me that #p502# has some #t4031010#, a key ingredient in making a #t4031011#.

0.0: So you're looking for a #b#t4031011##k? That stone is very rare. All right then, get me the items I list. Ready?
0.1: They say you can make a #b#t4031011##k if you have #b30 #t4000006#s#k, #b30 #t4000011#s#k, #b30 #t4000012#s#k, and #b1 #t4031010##k... You should be able to get most of them... but #t4031010# is going to be a problem. You should ask #b#p502##k for help; he is somewhere in town.

npc.0: If you have #b30 #t4000006#s#k, #b30 #t4000011#s#k, #b30 #t4000012#s#k, and #b1 #t4031010##k, you can make #b1 #t4031011##k... You should ask #b#p502##k about the #t4031010#... I think he is somewhere around #m10004000#.
